headword: {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}

definitions.explanation: Food produced using organic farming methods, without synthetic pesticides, chemical fertilizers, or genetically modified organisms.

examples.japanese: {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}を{選|えら}ぶようにしている。
examples.english: I try to choose organic food.

examples.japanese: このスーパーは{有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}の{品揃|しなぞろ}えが{豊富|ほうふ}だ。
examples.english: This supermarket has a wide selection of organic food.

examples.japanese: {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}は{普通|ふつう}の{食品|しょくひん}より{値段|ねだん}が{高|たか}いが、{健康|けんこう}や{環境|かんきょう}に{良|よ}いと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: Organic food is more expensive than regular food, but it's said to be better for your health and the environment.

notes:
A compound of {有機|ゆうき} (organic) and {食品|しょくひん} (food products). In Japan, the {有機|ゆうき}JAS{認証|にんしょう} (Organic JAS certification) is the official organic label regulated by the Ministry of Agriculture. Products must meet strict standards to carry the {有機|ゆうき} label.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}を{買|か}う — to buy organic food
- {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}コーナー — organic food section
- {有機食品|ゆうきしょくひん}の{市場|しじょう} — organic food market

RELATED WORDS:
- {有機野菜|ゆうきやさい} — organic vegetables
- {有機栽培|ゆうきさいばい} — organic farming/cultivation
- {無農薬|むのうやく} — pesticide-free (not the same as organic; organic certification covers more than just pesticides)
- {自然食品|しぜんしょくひん} — natural food (broader; may not meet organic certification standards)
